in_sanskrit.name: Bhaasvan
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhaas means to shine, and van means all or everywhere. So, Bhaasvan means the one who shines everywhere, or the Sun God.

in_hindi.name: सूरज
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sūraj is a direct translation of the English word 'Sun'. It is also the name of the Sun God in Hinduism.

in_tamil.name: சொன்னப்படு
in_tamil.long_meaning: Cōṉṉappaṭu is a poetic name for the Sun in Tamil. It can be translated to 'Sun that shines everywhere' or 'Sun that illuminates everything'.

in_telugu.name: శూరోజ్జు
in_telugu.long_meaning: Śūrōjju is a direct translation of the English word 'Sun'. It is also the name of the Sun God in Telugu Hinduism.

in_marathi.name: Bhaasvan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhaasvan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhaasvan is a Sanskrit name derived from 'Bhaas' meaning sun and 'van' meaning god or bearer. This name is associated with the Sun God, who is revered for his power, energy, and life-giving qualities.
